Tooltip_SEW_Enter: Prise the cover up by hand and climb down. A crowbar or a pipe wrench would make quicker work of it.
Tooltip_SEW_EnterTool: Lever the cover up and climb down.
Tooltip_SEW_Shut: Rusted into its seat. Whatever is under this one, nobody is getting to it from here.
Tooltip_SEW_ExitTo: Up the ladder and out onto %1.
Tooltip_SEW_Plan: One sheet of the town's storm sewers, drawn by the county. Reading it fills in that part of your sewer map.
Tooltip_SEW_Journal: Somebody who was down here before you. Reading it marks what they wrote about on your sewer map.
Tooltip_SEW_Hatch: Somebody cut a trapdoor in this floor. A ladder goes down into the dark.
Tooltip_SEW_HatchUp: Up the ladder, through a trapdoor, into somebody's house.
Tooltip_SEW_PryWall: This stretch of wall is not like the rest. The mortar is gone, and something has gnawed a hole at its foot the size of a dog. A crowbar or a sledgehammer would be quicker than your hands.
Tooltip_SEW_PryGate: Old brickwork, gnawed half through from this side. Whatever made the nest was trying to get at something behind it.
Tooltip_SEW_Key: Stamped DPW - COUNTY SEWERS. Opens the locked grilles on the county's rooms under one town. Keep it in your hands or on a key ring: in a bag it does nothing.
Tooltip_SEW_Outfall: An iron grate set into the bank where the town's storm water comes out. It lifts. A ladder goes down into the dark.
Tooltip_SEW_OutfallUp: Up the ladder and out through the grate, onto the bank by the water.
Tooltip_SEW_Trap: A trapdoor under the weeds, in the middle of nowhere. A ladder goes down into the dark, and something down there is burning.
Tooltip_SEW_TrapUp: Up the ladder and out through the trapdoor, into the field.
Tooltip_SEW_MineNoTool: Rock, brick and concrete. You need a pickaxe or a sledgehammer.
Tooltip_SEW_MinePick: Heavy work with the pickaxe, and loud. One square at a time.
Tooltip_SEW_MineHammer: Heavy work, slow with a sledgehammer, and loud. A pickaxe would be quicker.
